title: Coritiba and Botafogo face off this Monday in the Brasileirão
seoTitle: Coritiba vs Botafogo: Brasileirão clash this Monday
subtitle: Match valid for the 30th round of the Brazilian Championship will be at 4 PM (Brasília time) at Couto Pereira
excerpt: Coritiba and Botafogo take the field this Monday, at 4 PM, at Couto Pereira, for the 30th round. Both arrive with important absences and the search for points that.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Coritiba and Botafogo face off this Monday, at 4 PM (Brasília time), at Couto Pereira Stadium, in a match valid for the 30th round of the Brazilian Championship. The clash gains prominence as both teams arrive needing to score points to improve their standing in the table.

Direct Clash and Table Position

Coritiba (nicknamed "Coxa") has 38 points and occupies the middle of the standings, while Botafogo is in 13th place with 35 points. Coxa seeks to end a 40-day winless streak; their last victory was 3-2 over Remo, on August 31st. Botafogo, in turn, is looking for its first win in the Tite era after a 2-1 defeat to Vasco.

Coritiba Absences and Doubts

Coritiba has three confirmed absences: Bruno Melo (suspended due to his third yellow card), Lucas Ronier (ACL surgery), and Jacy (doubtful after an injury against Fluminense). In defense, Tiago Cóser has muscle edema; if he doesn't play, the center-back duo could be Maicon and Rodrigo Moledo. Goalkeeper Pedro Morisco, rested in the last game, is expected to start, as is forward Lavega, who did not play against Fluminense due to contractual issues.

Botafogo Absences and Doubts

Botafogo takes the field without Tite, suspended due to an expulsion against Vasco. In defense, Arthur Chaves is out after tests ruled out a fracture, but he will remain resting. Lucas Monzón is also absent due to calf muscle pain. The center-back duo is expected to be Justino alongside Ferraresi. Among the new developments, Montoro returns to the starting lineup, and Tiquinho Soares could start alongside Arthur Cabral.

Broadcast and Live Coverage

The match will be broadcast live on Amazon Prime. The ge portal will follow all the action in Real Time, offering minute-by-minute updates for fans.

Expectations for the Duel

With key players absent, both clubs may adopt different strategies. Coritiba will rely on Pedro Morisco's experience and Lavega's presence in attack, while Botafogo is banking on Montoro and Tiquinho Soares to create danger. The result will be crucial in determining whether Coxa ends its winless streak and if Botafogo moves away from the relegation zone.

With information from ge, CartaCapital, O Dia.
